correctness.rationale: For GP(n,2), n odd >=5, each of n five-cycles has odd frustration; outer edges and spokes appear twice and inner edges once, giving f>=(n+1)/2 and E>=-(2n-1)J. Rebuilt the eight-state transition M=y^-1 T(y^2) from the exact displayed state compatibility rule; an independent symbolic determinant calculation verified D(t,0)=1-3t^4+t^8 and [y]D=-2(t^3+t^5). Log determinant then extracts the first possible frustration coefficient 2n[t^n](t^3+t^5)/(1-3t^4+t^8), equal to stated Fibonacci counts; positivity proves the bound sharp. Exhaustive direct spin enumeration on n=5,7,9 gave 10,42,54 labelled ground states. Classical uniform AF zero-field model only, not positive temperatures or even n.
